defectStep: PartnerNetPricePosthook.resolveContributorCarryForwardByMaintenanceQuoteLines / buildContributorCarryForwardSnapshot / resolveContributorPartnerPercent (line ~1514): returns contributorLine.PartnerDiscountPercent (license Software band = 15) and propagates it via ContributorCarryForwardSnapshot.partnerPercent; loadNewMaintenanceLines (line ~1372) then sets partnerPercent = contributor.partnerPercent for the New Maintenance line. The general partner path that DOES resolve the correct band (getMarginForProductType, line ~569) is explicitly bypassed for derived maintenance by isDerivedMaintenanceProductType (line 550-552 returns null for 'New Maintenance'/'Renewal Maintenance'). So the derived-maint branch never calls getMarginForProductType(model,'New Maintenance')=12 and instead carries the contributor's 15%.
proposedFix: In the derived-maintenance partner path (loadNewMaintenanceLines / computeNewBusinessMaintenanceNets), resolve the partner percent from the Quote's Partner_Pricing_Model__c via PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, 'New Maintenance') instead of inheriting ContributorCarryForwardSnapshot.partnerPercent from the contributor line. Keep carrying the contributor's PRE-partner price (355) as the derived list base; only the discount-percent band lookup is wrong. (Do NOT delete the carry-forward of pricingBase, only stop carrying partnerPercent.)
